MARION COUNTY POLICE DEPARTMENT
ADVISEMENT OF RIGHTS AND WAIVER

Subject: Daniel R. Ortega
Date: 03/15/2024
Time of Advisement: 00:11
Location: 4500 Linden Avenue (street-side, prior to transport)
Advising Officer: M. Halberg #4471
Witness Officer: J. Bell #4502

The following rights were read aloud:
1. You have the right to remain silent.
2. Anything you say can and will be used against you in a court of law.
3. You have the right to an attorney.
4. If you cannot afford an attorney, one will be appointed.

Subject's response (verbatim, per Officer Halberg's report): "I want a lawyer."

Subject signature: [NOT OBTAINED — subject was handcuffed and declined to sign]
Officer signature: /s/ M. Halberg, 03/15/2024 00:13

ADDITIONAL NOTES:
At 00:24 — after the Miranda invocation above and after subject had been placed in the rear of patrol unit #112 — Officer Halberg asked subject, "Where did you ditch the phone?" Subject responded, "I don't know what you're talking about." No further questioning occurred.

Body-worn camera footage of the advisement is preserved as Evidence Item 2.
